Job Summary**

We are seeking a diligent and skilled Commercial Hatchery Operator to join our team at the CF Lengkong facility. This role involves the effective and efficient operation of hatchery equipment and processes to ensure the production of high-quality chicks, contributing to the overall success of our poultry operations.

Job Responsibilities**

* Operate and monitor various hatchery equipment, including incubators, hatchers, and ventilation systems, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to established protocols.
* Conduct regular checks and maintenance of hatchery machinery and equipment, reporting any malfunctions or issues promptly to the supervisor.
* Assist with egg setting, chick processing (e.g., vaccination, sexing, grading), and chick dispatch activities, maintaining high standards of biosecurity and animal welfare.
* Record and maintain accurate data related to egg setting, hatch rates, chick quality, and environmental parameters.
* Adhere strictly to all biosecurity procedures and sanitation protocols within the hatchery to prevent disease transmission.
* Monitor environmental conditions within the hatchery, including temperature, humidity, and CO2 levels, and make necessary adjustments to ensure optimal conditions for embryo development and chick health.
* Identify and report any abnormalities or deviations in egg or chick quality to the supervisor.
* Participate in training programs and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and product quality.
* Comply with all company policies, safety regulations, and industry standards.

Job Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Proven experience working in a commercial hatchery or a similar agricultural/production environment is highly preferred.
* Basic understanding of poultry farming principles and hatchery operations.
* Ability to operate and troubleshoot basic machinery and equipment.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards of quality and hygiene.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment and follow instructions.
* Good physical stamina, capable of performing tasks that may require lifting and standing for extended periods.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as required by hatchery operations.
* Basic literacy and numeracy skills for data recording.
* Knowledge of biosecurity protocols is an advantage.




JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-klbf-JR26_000450.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION:

• Team Leadership & Supervision
• Direct supervision of the Business Analyst/Project Officer, including workload distribution, performance evaluations, and professional development.
• Act as the final reviewer and "editor-in-chief" for all deliverables produced by the Officer (e.g., project logs, process maps, and requirement documents).
• Coach the team on best practices in requirements gathering, data visualization, and stakeholder management.
• Strategic Business Analysis
• Lead the discovery phase for high-priority projects, identifying root causes of business friction and proposing scalable solutions.
• Design and implement "To-Be" processes that improve organizational efficiency and ROI.
• Ensure the integrity of data used for business cases and project reporting, translating complex datasets into actionable executive insights.
• End-to-End Project Management
• Define project charters, success metrics, and resource plans for cross-departmental initiatives.
• Identify potential project "red flags" (budget, timeline, or technical) and lead the mitigation efforts before they impact the business.
• Overseeing the creation of training programs and managing User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Stakeholder & Vendor Management
• Serve as the primary bridge between technical teams (IT/Dev) and business units.
• Manage expectations of senior stakeholders, providing transparent reporting and handling conflicting priorities with diplomacy.

REQUIREMENTS:

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree (S1) Information Systems, Data Science, or Business Administration.
• Professional Experience: 3+ years of progressive experience in business analytics or project management, with at least 1–2 years in a lead capacity where they were responsible for reviewing the work of junior staff.
• Technical Skills
• Project Management Frameworks: Deep understanding of the DLM (Digital Lifecycle Management) and the ability to pivot between Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall depending on the project.
• Documentation: Advanced skills in writing Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD).
• Process Modeling: Advanced-level proficiency in Business Process Management and using relevant tools.
• Data Visualization & Quality: High proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
• Soft Skills
• Critical Thinking
• Synthesizing Complexity
• Attention to Detail
• Instructional Leadership
• Conflict Resolution & Diplomacy

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
